issues.where: PickerCarouselFeatureCycle.tsx lines 120-127 (icon span, ICONS[5] U+21BA); fa frame 107 (final resting frame) and f90
issues.problem: Round-1 finding NOT fixed. The span now has an explicit fontFamily stack (-apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI Symbol), but the re-rendered fa f107 still shows a tiny curled hook that reads like an Arabic letter (ى) instead of the open counter-clockwise refresh arrow seen in orig f107. The system-font stack does not resolve U+21BA in the render environment, so the glyph still comes from a wrong fallback. The header comment claims the symbol icons preserve the source glyph design, which is false for this icon.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the U+21BA text glyph with a small inline SVG (about 14-16px open circular arrow, currentColor stroke, same opacity logic), or use a font verified to carry U+21BA in this environment. Re-render f90 and f107 and compare with orig.

issues.problem: Badge font stack is not the original Helvetica; the AI mark falls back to a rounder sans and keeps letterSpacing 0.5. Mirroring the badge to the right is defensible and now documented in the header.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: leave as is, or use a Latin sans verified to be present so the mark matches the source.
